Pseudomonas striata is also a phosphate solubiliser, not linked to nitrogenase (used in nitrogen fixation); VAM aids phosphorus and water uptake, not denitrification; Nitrobacter converts nitrite to nitrate in nitrification, not phosphate uptake.
India has 96 Ramsar sites, whose fauna ZSI has documented at 8,213 species. India joined the Ramsar Convention (signed 1971 at Ramsar, Iran) in 1982.

Topsoil is depleted by brick production (topsoil mining), so B is right. The other pairs are wrong: groundwater is depleted by deep bore tubewells for irrigation, biodiversity habitats by expansion of agriculture, and land for buildings by urban construction on water bodies.
Clearing for agriculture, urbanisation, industry and mining are the drivers of deforestation. Improved soil-moisture retention is not a driver; deforestation in fact lowers soil-moisture retention.
SPSR Nellore targets 50% green cover by 2047 (Jul 2026) under the Great Green Wall of Andhra Pradesh, which aims to raise green cover and combat desertification.
Under SDG 15 (SDG India Index 2023-24), degraded land is 33.81% of AP, about ten times Punjab's 3.15%. 18.28% is AP's forest cover and 21.26% its fallow-land share.

FAO FRA 2025 puts forests at about 32% of Earth's land. 54% is the share of forests held by five countries (Russia, Brazil, Canada, USA, China), and 21.76 (Mha) is the land India restored in 2011-2020.

Respiration, decomposition, fossil-fuel combustion and volcanic activity all add CO2. Each other option includes a process that removes CO2: photosynthesis, dissolution in oceans, carbonate sedimentation or silicate weathering.

The UNCCD is the only legally binding framework on desertification and drought, so B is right. C reverses the dates: it was adopted in 1994 (Paris) and came into force in 1996. D is wrong because it is one of the three Rio conventions, not part of the Montreal Protocol.
